verdict.rationale: LM Studio's local-first architecture (models, chats, configs all stored on-device, per docs-6 and docs-27) and explicit claims that certain data 'is processed locally and never leaves your device' (docs-32) imply user control over data by virtue of not transmitting it, but there is no documented explicit retention/deletion settings, data export, or 'clear history' controls in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion UI or settings documentation, first-party statement on how long local data/logs persist, independent confirmation of a deletion workflow.
